Market today: The market mood is cautious for tech/chips, driven by a significant $1 trillion selloff in chip stocks. This directly impacts your concentrated portfolio, especially QQQ, SMH, and SOXL, which are heavily exposed to this sector.

Your holdings: SOXL (-56.96%) and SPAL (-54.75%) are leveraged with massive losses and ineffective stops far above current prices. SMH (-16.78%) also has a stop set above its current price. Remember, margin amplifies these drawdowns.

Watch: Closely monitor QQQ and QQQI as they approach their stops. Also, keep an eye on the broader chip sector for any signs of stabilization or further decline.

Bottom line: Prioritize immediate risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions to protect capital.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL stops: Your SOXL and SPAL stops are far above current prices; these leveraged positions need immediate stop adjustment to protect capital.
Monitor QQQ and QQQI: QQQ and QQQI are nearing their stops; be ready to act if those levels break, especially with chip weakness.
Consider SOXS: With chip stocks selling off, SOXS (inverse semiconductor) could be a tactical hedge. Scanner entry 61.49-61.07, stop 60.33.
